name: mirage
text: Still 0 right now, and here is what I've done. The live lane was reading only SX Bet, which had no games in play, while SharpAPI's live Pinnacle feed showed 5 to 14 games live. So I switched the lane's feed to SharpAPI, added ATP and WTA to the leagues, and restarted the engine at 05:40 UTC, because the lane opens its feed only once when the engine starts. The new run (39729525869) came up at 05:44 and its SharpAPI store is still loading, so the board is empty for now. I'm watching it, and if it's still 0 a few minutes after the store loads, I'll trace where the games drop out. Orders on this feed stay paper-only, because SharpAPI's real-orders switch is off and I haven't touched it. SX Bet's real live orders are paused as a result. To undo the feed change, run engine_set.py pinnWebsite.feed=SX.
